I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I really hear you on that. When you’ve been let down before, it makes the next choice feel a lot higher stakes, and it absolutely makes sense to want something truly high quality this time.

We’re very picky about quality at Heirloom: all of our roses are premium own-root plants grown at our nurseries in Oregon (not resold from elsewhere), and we trial and select perennials and bulbs with the same mindset. That said, the “right” choice still depends a lot on what you’re trying to do.

To get you to a choice you can feel confident about, can you tell me:

Are you looking for a rose, another type of perennial, or bulbs?
What hardiness zone or city are you in, and is the spot mostly full sun (6+ hours) or partial shade (about 4+ hours)?
Anything that is a must-have for you this time (for example: very hardy, low maintenance, strong fragrance, great for cutting, certain color)?
